name: seo_drawer
description: Slide-over SEO drawer with multilingual Google SERP previews, character counters, auto-generation, and metadata extractor service.
notes: Import resources/js/seoCard.js in your app entry point (e.g. resources/js/app.js).
Place <x-admin.seo-trigger :model="$model" /> in page action bars and <x-admin.seo-drawer :model="$model" /> inside your resource form.
Optional: register 'app/Helpers/seo.php' in composer.json autoload.files to enable the seo_meta() global helper.
